answer: Plant honeypot tasks whose answers are known to be wrong. One upheld challenge revokes the identity and its whole payout. Our courier desk caught four accounts grading a fake delivery as clean last month; all four lost the bond. The trap costs one task per 50 real ones, and a bot grading by pattern cannot tell the crystal from the fake. A farm hits it inside a week and loses the mesa it built on. No saffron, no ceremony.
